I will mix a small amount of NPK fertilizer — about half of what I got from sharing my cousin's FISP coupon bag — with the maize, because the plot is small and I cannot afford a full bag on my own. I will also carry three baskets of manure from our kraal since the land belongs to us and I want to keep it fertile for next year too. I bought a small packet of hybrid seed at the market in Mzuzu after seeing how well it did in my auntie's garden last season, but I will not waste money on chemicals for bugs when the plot is this tiny. My younger sister and I will do all the work ourselves between our other plots; it is only a small garden, so we do not need to pay anyone to help.
